# Laravel Lang Sync Inertia (erag/laravel-lang-sync-inertia)

> Seamlessly export and synchronize Laravel PHP language & translation files directly to Inertia.js frontend applications with Vue, React, and Svelte i18n helpers. Zero custom API endpoints and native SSR hydration.

## Installation

### 1. Laravel Backend Package
```bash
composer require erag/laravel-lang-sync-inertia
```

### 2. Frontend NPM Package
```bash
npm install @erag/lang-sync-inertia
```

### 3. Publish Configuration & Assets
```bash
php artisan erag:install-lang
```

- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/laravel-lang-sync-inertia/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-lang-sync-inertia
- **Packagist**: https://packagist.org/packages/erag/laravel-lang-sync-inertia
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@erag/lang-sync-inertia
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Keywords**: laravel, inertiajs, i18n, translations, localization, vue, react, svelte

## Quick Start

### 1. Backend Controller Usage
Call `syncLangFiles()` before returning your Inertia response:
```php
use Inertia\Inertia;
use Inertia\Response;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    public function index(): Response
    {
        syncLangFiles();

        return Inertia::render('Dashboard', [
            'stats' => $this->getStats(),
        ]);
    }
}
```

Or share globally in `HandleInertiaRequests` middleware:
```php
public function share(Request $request): array
{
    syncLangFiles();

    return array_merge(parent::share($request), [
        // other shared props
    ]);
}
```

### 2. Vue 3 Integration
```typescript
// resources/js/app.ts
import { createApp, h } from 'vue'
import { createInertiaApp } from '@inertiajs/vue3'
import { vueLang } from '@erag/lang-sync-inertia/vue'

createInertiaApp({
  resolve: (name) => {
    const pages = import.meta.glob('./Pages/**/*.vue', { eager: true })
    return pages[`./Pages/${name}.vue`]
  },
  setup({ el, App, props, plugin }) {
    createApp({ render: () => h(App, props) })
      .use(plugin)
      .use(vueLang)
      .mount(el)
  },
})
```

Inside Vue template:
```vue
<template>
  <h1>{{ __('messages.welcome', { name: user.name }) }}</h1>
  <p>{{ trans('auth.failed') }}</p>
</template>
```

### 3. React Integration
```tsx
// resources/js/Pages/Dashboard.tsx
import React from 'react'
import { reactLang } from '@erag/lang-sync-inertia/react'

export default function Dashboard({ user }) {
  const { __, trans } = reactLang()

  return (
    <div>
      <h1>{__('messages.welcome', { name: user.name })}</h1>
      <p>{trans('auth.failed')}</p>
    </div>
  )
}
```

### 4. Svelte 5 Integration
```svelte
<script>
  import { svelteLang } from '@erag/lang-sync-inertia/svelte'

  const { __, trans } = svelteLang()
</script>

<h1>{__('messages.welcome', { name: 'Amit' })}</h1>
```
